{{Item|Bingo Ring|amount=1}} }} '''Bingo Artifact''' is a {{Rare}} [[Accessory]], purchasable from {{NPCSprite|Bingo}}. == Obtaining == '''Bingo Artifact''' can be purchased from {{BingoText|shop}} for {{Item|Bingo Ring|amount=1}} and {{Bingo Points|150}} once the player has reached {{BingoText|3}}. == Usage == {{Item|Bingo Relic}} can be bought from {{BingoText|shop}} with {{Green|1x}} {{Item|Bingo Artifact}} and {{Bingo Points|200}} once the player has reached {{BingoText|4}}. == Trivia == * Alongside {{Item|Hegemony Artifact}} and {{Item|Hocus-Pocus Cipher}} (outside of the rift) it does not grant any effects, which means it can only grant boosts through [[Accessory Powers]]. * The lore of the item is a reference to the children's song [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9mmF8zOlh_g BINGO], where the letters of the word are sung to spell out the name of a farmer's dog. **Furthermore, when playing the game Bingo, columns are often distinguished by those letters as opposed to A, B, C... == History == {{History table |beta= {{History|2021/November 29|link=none|[[File:Bingo Artifact.png|26px]] Added '''Bingo Artifact'''.}} {{History|2022/May 29|link=none|'''Bingo Artifact''' becomes obtainable.}} {{History|2022/January 28|link=none|'''Bingo Artifact''' is no longer {{Pink|Co-op Soulbound}}.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Events/Bingo}} {{Nav/Accessories}}
